1.w: For the music director, according to the yonath-elem-rekhoqim style; a prayer of David, written when the Philistines captured him in Gath. Have mercy on me, O God, for men are attacking me. All day long hostile enemies are tormenting me.

2.w: Those who anticipate my defeat attack me all day long. Indeed, many are fighting against me, O Exalted One.

3.w: When I am afraid, I trust in you.

4.w: In God—I boast in his promise — in God I trust; I am not afraid. What can mere men do to me?

5.w: All day long they cause me trouble; they make a habit of plotting my demise.

6.w: They stalk and lurk; they watch my every step, as they prepare to take my life.

7.w: Because they are bent on violence, do not let them escape. In your anger bring down the nations, O God.

8.w: You keep track of my misery. Put my tears in your leather container. Are they not recorded in your scroll?

9.w: My enemies will turn back when I cry out to you for help; I know that God is on my side.

10.w: In God—I boast in his promise — in the Lord—I boast in his promise —

11.w: in God I trust; I am not afraid. What can mere men do to me?

12.w: I am obligated to fulfill the vows I made to you, O God; I will give you the thank offerings you deserve,

13.w: when you deliver my life from death. You keep my feet from stumbling, so that I might serve God as I enjoy life.
